dm_commodification.definition: The treatment of a person as a product that can be valued and exchanged.
dm_commodification.example: The whole conversation turned her into a commodity, and she left the table.

gravity.definition: The pull of the Earth that pulls everything downwards, including airplanes.
gravity.example: Lift has to be stronger than gravity to keep the plane up.

macronutrient.definition: One of the three nutrients the body needs in quantity: carbohydrate, fat and protein.
macronutrient.example: The main macronutrient in this product is fat, not carbohydrate.

puzzle.definition: A game with many pieces. You fit the pieces together to make a picture.
puzzle.example: I finished the puzzle before dinner.
